name: The same number of senators voted for and against the [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2020-11-12.35.1) moved by Senator [Katy Gallagher](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/act/katy_gallagher), which meant it failed. ### Amendment text > *"but, in respect of the Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation Amendment (Streamlining Environmental Approvals) Bill 2020, the Environment and Communications Legislation Committee report by 3 February 2021."* ### Original motion text > *That the [report](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2020-11-12.34.3) be adopted.*
